# Sticker and emoji packs

**Telegram stickers, custom emoji and Discord emoji in one consistent style, exported to exact specs with tested scripts.**

Makes Telegram sticker packs, Telegram custom emoji, Discord emoji, Discord server stickers and reaction GIFs for an AI character — one consistent style across 12–30 expressions, generated with references and transparent backgrounds, checked for legibility at 100 px, and exported with tested scripts to each platform's exact specs (512 px PNG/WEBP or VP9 WEBM ≤ 3 s and ≤ 256 KB for Telegram, 128 px ≤ 256 KiB emoji and 320 px ≤ 512 KiB stickers for Discord, checked 2026-10), then uploaded and announced with an AI label. Use when someone wants a sticker pack, emoji set, reaction GIFs or animated stickers for a Telegram channel or Discord server.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 3–4 h for a 12-sticker pack | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Plan the pack in the character's voice
2. Lock one style and one character block
3. Make the style anchor first
4. Add words and test at real size
5. Export static files to spec
6. Export animated stickers and GIFs
7. Upload to each platform
8. Label it and announce with approval

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/sticker-and-emoji-packs.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/sticker-and-emoji-packs.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/sticker-and-emoji-packs.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/sticker-and-emoji-packs.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill sticker-and-emoji-packs`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `sticker-and-emoji-packs.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/sticker-and-emoji-packs`.
